authoritative_host_decision.rationale: apps/signal-ingest processes all inbound telemetry from autonomous agent workloads and external providers, validating SPIFFE SVID credentials, enforcing fine-grained actor permissions, and maintaining cryptographic audit journals. It is the sole authoritative host where Cofide Go SDK interceptor middleware can validate cross-trust-zone mTLS attestation and SVID exchanges.

illustrative_strings_found.text: Every table on this page reads from an array literal declared in the page file. The trust domains, SVID expiries and bundle-exchange states are illustrative, chosen to show the shape of a federated deployment.
